name: Laura Friedman
stance: Opposes federal preemption of state AI laws, including the 2025 moratorium and the executive order on state AI laws, and says Congress must ensure powerful AI is safe.

statements.text: Led nine House colleagues in a letter to Defense Secretary Hegseth on the Pentagon's $200 million xAI contract for Grok for Government, asking whether Elon Musk can alter the model's outputs, what safeguards and independent audits are in place, and whether Grok's extremist outputs could recur in military applications.

I stood up and helped stop an AI regulation ban that House Republicans tried to sneak into the Big, Ugly Bill earlier this year. Now the Trump administration is trying to override Congress & enforce a ban through executive order.
And it’s Congress’ responsibility to insure that powerful tech is safe and a net positive.
